engine_summary_note: BOTH calls returned an engine summary paragraph. NEITHER WAS USED FOR ANY PURPOSE. Each refusal is itemised in 'engine_syntheses_refused' so a successor can see exactly what was refused rather than inferring it from silence.

engine_syntheses_refused.refused: The engine paragraph's statement that the tribunal 'rejected the claim that judicial invalidation of patents constituted a breach of either Article 1110 (Expropriation) or Article 1105 (Minimum Standard of Treatment) of NAFTA'.
engine_syntheses_refused.ground: Two independent grounds. (i) It describes NAFTA Article 1110 and Article 1105 by content; NO SEAT MAY DESCRIBE NAFTA ARTICLE 1110'S INTERNAL STRUCTURE - this project has never read it, and an engine synthesis offering exactly that was refused on 2026-09-26. (ii) It is a tribunal HOLDING offered by a search engine, which the candidate-claims contract permits only from a primary source.

engine_syntheses_refused.refused: The engine paragraph's account of the tribunal's treatment of 'abus de droit' - that domestic-court determinations are unreviewable 'save in the extraordinary circumstance of gross procedural misconduct amounting to a denial of justice, or where court power ... is exercised in bad faith to mask a violation of international law'.
engine_syntheses_refused.ground: A holding, and a quotation, from a body no seat opened. It is also the exact doctrinal sentence that would answer an open question in the record, which is the strongest possible reason to refuse it rather than the weakest.

engine_syntheses_refused.refused: Tribunal composition (van den Berg, presiding; Born; Bethlehem), the award date 16 March 2017, and the costs figure CAD 4.5 million.
engine_syntheses_refused.ground: Search-synthesis figures. The award date is separately already in living memory at STATE_OF_THE_ANSWER.md:884 from the project's own sourcing; this seat neither re-asserts it nor corroborates it from an engine paragraph. The costs figure has NO carrier in this repository and enters nothing.

engine_syntheses_refused.refused: 'The case is significant for establishing that investment tribunals have limited jurisdiction over intellectual property matters and domestic patent law determinations.'
engine_syntheses_refused.ground: An evaluative characterisation of a holding, from an engine. It is also precisely the proposition this project's Ring-3 work exists to test, and importing it as background would settle by repetition what the record has open.

engine_syntheses_refused.refused: The engine paragraph's statements about what the European Medical Association 'has recognized' and 'has also concluded' regarding which clinical-trial data qualify as confidential commercial information, and about the American Chamber of Commerce's TRIPS warning.
engine_syntheses_refused.ground: Attributed institutional positions with no body opened. This is the project's central sub-question (clinical-trial data as a protectable asset) and is exactly where an unsourced synthesis would do the most damage.

engine_syntheses_refused.refused: The engine paragraph's historical account of the customary-international-law minimum standard of treatment.
engine_syntheses_refused.ground: Treatise-level synthesis from an engine; no locator, no body.

calls.query: "Eli Lilly v. Canada" "abuse of right" tribunal later award cited intellectual property jurisdiction investment treaty
calls.query_shape: 2 exact phrases + 9 bare terms; unrestricted; blocked_domains only
calls.purpose: Test a formulation class this project has NEVER fired: a SEED-AWARD NAME as a query ingredient, used as a citator to reach later tribunals citing the seed award on the Ring-3 limb. Measured hole: across the 126 recoverable query strings (93 prose-recovered pre-floor + 33 post-floor JSON), 'Eli Lilly' occurs 0 times, 'Philip Morris' 0, 'Bridgestone' 0, 'UNCT/14/2' 0, 'ARB/16/34' 0, 'PCA 2012-12' 0.
calls.outcome: HONEST NULL ON THE QUESTION ASKED, AND A METHOD FINDING. Not one of the ten rows is a later tribunal or award citing Eli Lilly v. Canada. Every row is the case itself or commentary on the case itself: the Government of Canada statement page, a CanLII commentary, IISD ITN's 2017 award report, the UNCTAD Navigator case page, a Lexology note, a ResearchGate PDF entry, an Elgar QMJIP article, a Kluwer JOIA article, an SSRN paper, and a RePEc World Trade Review entry. The seed-award NAME collapses the result set onto the seed award. The 2026-07-26 lesson (author-name + exact title beat keyword search) therefore does NOT transfer to case level as a citator: a case name is a strong retrieval key for the case and a useless one for its descendants.

calls.query: "trade secrets" "minimum standard of treatment" investment treaty tribunal covered investment clinical trial data claim
calls.query_shape: 2 exact phrases + 9 bare terms; unrestricted; blocked_domains only
calls.purpose: Fire a designator that is VERBATIM in this project's own statement of the research question (prompts/research_analyst.txt:17, 'breach of the minimum standard of treatment') and that occurs ZERO times in the 126 recoverable query strings. Cell: R1+R2.
calls.outcome: HONEST NULL AT CASE LEVEL. Nine rows, not one of them an investor-State claim in which trade secrets or clinical-trial data were asserted as a covered investment. The set is: two ICSID party-filed legal-authority PDFs titled 'Chapter 6 - Minimum Standards of Treatment', an OECD 2004 FET working paper, a treatise chapter on ResearchGate, and five domestic/policy items on trade-secret and clinical-data protection (NCBI, HHR Journal, National Law Review, Mintz, infojustice). SCOPE OF THIS NULL, STATED TIGHTLY: it is ONE call, ONE engine, ONE moment, title level only, no body opened. It is NOT a claim that no such case exists; per the cross-BIT consistency discipline the finding is 'not found in accessible sources'. The 'consecutive sessions' framing is expressly NOT available and was struck from this field before publication: the R1+R2 cell was fired on 2026-09-20 (1 call), 2026-09-24 (1), 2026-09-26 (4) and today (1) - four DATES, not four consecutive sessions, since 2026-09-21, 09-22 and 09-25 fired none. And this seat verified the returned-nothing outcome only for TODAY'S call and for 2026-09-26 as that record states it; it asserts nothing about what 09-20 or 09-24 returned.
